;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings]]
**[[Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for the bombings in [[Sri Lanka]] that took place on Easter Sunday. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/23/world/asia/sri-lanka-bombing.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Sri Lankan investigators believe that the bombings were revenge for [[Christchurch mosque shootings|attacks on New Zealand mosques]] in March. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sri-lanka-blasts/sri-lanka-bomb-attacks-were-revenge-for-new-zealand-mosque-killings-minister-idUSKCN1RZ06M (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Federal Aviation Administration]] (FAA) certifies [[Alphabet Inc.]]-owned [[delivery drone]] service [[Wing (company)|Wing]] to operate as an [[airline]] in the [[United States]]. Wing is the first delivery drone company to receive FAA air carrier certification. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-drone-alphabet/faa-paves-way-for-alphabet-unit-to-make-first-u-s-drone-deliveries-idUKKCN1RZ25R (Reuters)] [https://www.npr.org/2019/04/23/716360818/faa-certifies-googles-wing-drone-delivery-company-to-operate-as-an-airline (NPR)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Visayas earthquake]]
**A magnitude 6.5 [[earthquake]] strikes the islands of [[Visayas]] in the [[Philippines]] at 13:37 [[Philippine Standard Time]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/23/19/62-magnitude-quake-hits-eastern-samar (ABS-CBN News)]
**According to [[Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology|PHIVOLCS]], the [[epicenter]] of the earthquake is located {{convert|9|km|mi}} northwest of [[San Julian, Eastern Samar|San Julian]], [[Eastern Samar]]. PHIVOLCS originally records the earthquake, which is tectonic in origin, at magnitude 6.2, but later upgrades it to 6.5. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2019/04/23/1911918/phivolcs-upgrades-magnitude-65-quake-jolted-eastern-samar-town (''The Philippine Star'')]
**The earthquake happened less than 24 hours after the [[2019 Luzon earthquake|6.1 magnitude earthquake that struck Luzon]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/23/19/62-magnitude-quake-hits-eastern-samar (ABS-CBN News)]
*A [[Mudflow|mudslide]] at a [[Jade trade in Myanmar|jade mine]] in [[Hpakant]], [[Kachin State]], northern [[Myanmar]] caused by the collapse of a nearby lake kills three miners and leaves 51 missing. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/23/asia/myanmar-jade-mine-accident-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[Korean Central News Agency]] confirms [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] will soon visit Russia for a summit with [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-russia/north-korea-confirms-leader-kim-jong-un-to-visit-russia-for-summit-with-putin-idUSKCN1RY1KT (Reuters)]
*[[Canada–Philippines relations]]
**[[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] insists [[Canada]] remove tons of mislabeled, misdirected trash from [[Manila]] that arrived in 2013 and 2014. Duterte threatens to retaliate, up to [[Declaration of war|declaring war]], if the trash is not removed. [https://www.npr.org/2019/04/24/716692612/philippines-duterte-talks-trash-literally-to-canada-threatening-war-over-garbage (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[Murder of Karina Vetrano]]
**In the United States, [[Chanel Lewis]] is sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for the 2016 [[murder (United States law)|murder]] of Karina Vetrano while she was running  in [[Queens]], New York City. The judge had earlier declined the defense's motion of a re-trial due to what they alleged to be police and juror misconduct. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/queens-jogger-sentenced-life-prison/story?id=62573087 (ABC)]
*Eight pedestrians in [[Sunnyvale, California]], are injured when a car is intentionally driven into them. The driver is arrested after crashing into a tree. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] is assisting in the investigation. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/eight-pedestrians-struck-car-suspected-intentional-crash-n997911 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Prince Edward Island general election]] and [[2019 Prince Edward Island electoral reform referendum|electoral reform referendum]]
**The [[Progressive Conservative Party of Prince Edward Island]] wins its first minority government since the [[1890 Prince Edward Island general election|Island's 1890 general election]]; while the [[Green Party of Prince Edward Island]] has beaten the [[Prince Edward Island Liberal Party]] by taking most of all their seats and becoming the province's new Official Opposition party, a first for any Green Party in North America. [https://www.theepochtimes.com/voters-in-prince-edward-island-elect-tory-minority-amid-green-surge_2892527.html (''The Epoch Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/24/prince-edward-island-elevates-green-party-to-opposition-in-canadian-first (The Guardian)] Voters also reject adopting [[mixed-member proportional representation]] as the province's election system in a referendum held simultaneously with the election. [https://www.theguardian.pe.ca/news/pei-election/no-side-pleased-with-status-quo-after-pei-electoral-reform-referendum-305151/ (''The Guardian'')]
